cv.tagline: I build back ends that stay fast when traffic grows.

perfis.foco: My main stack is Node.js with NestJS and PostgreSQL. At Example Store I build the APIs behind checkout and coupons, with RabbitMQ for background jobs.
I spent three years building Laravel applications with MySQL, and I later led the move from that PHP monolith to services.
